pick.headline: Jaruzelski elected president of Poland
pick.fbis: The East Europe Daily Report of July 19, 1989, carried Warsaw PAP reports on the eve of the vote: Kiszczak urging his backers to vote for Jaruzelski, a spokesman denying Western accounts of Jaruzelski's closed meeting with the Solidarity deputies' club, and the Christian Social Union backing him.

alternates.headline: Sandinistas enter Managua
alternates.fbis: The Latin America Daily Report of July 19, 1979, filled its Nicaragua contents with the regime's collapse: Urcuyo handing power to the Reconstruction Junta and leaving, the National Guard surrendering, the junta installed in Leon and due in Managua, and Sandinists urged to keep fighting.

alternates.headline: AUB president David Dodge kidnapped in Beirut
alternates.fbis: The Middle East review in the Daily Report of July 20, 1982, noted in one line that Beirut radio reported the kidnapping of David Dodge, acting president of the American University of Beirut, near the university.

evidence.title: FBIS Daily Report: Middle East & Africa, Vol. V No. 139, 20 July 1982
evidence.snippet: Meanwhile, Beirut radio reported that Acting President of the American University in Beirut David Dodge was kidnapped near the university.
